quote: In order to verify compliance with the principles of GMP for APIs, regular internal audits should be performed in accordance with an approved schedule.
statement: Regular internal audits are carried out to an approved schedule to verify compliance with GMP principles for APIs.

quote: In order to verify compliance with the principles of GMP for APIs, regular internal audits should be performed in accordance with an approved schedule.
statement: Regular internal audits are carried out to an approved schedule to verify compliance with GMP principles for APIs.

quote: In order to verify compliance with the principles of GMP for APIs, regular internal audits should be performed in accordance with an approved schedule.
statement: Regular internal audits are carried out to an approved schedule to verify compliance with GMP principles for APIs.

quote: Audit findings and corrective actions should be documented and brought to the attention of responsible management of the firm.
statement: Audit findings and corrective actions are documented and reported to the firm's responsible management.

quote: Audit findings and corrective actions should be documented and brought to the attention of responsible management of the firm.
statement: Audit findings and corrective actions are documented and reported to the firm's responsible management.

quote: Agreed corrective actions should be completed in a timely and effective manner.
statement: Agreed corrective actions are completed in a timely and effective way.

quote: Agreed corrective actions should be completed in a timely and effective manner.
statement: Agreed corrective actions are completed in a timely and effective way.

quote: Self inspections should be conducted in order to monitor the implementation and compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice principles and to propose necessary corrective measures.
statement: Self-inspections are carried out to monitor implementation of and compliance with GMP principles and to propose any corrective measures needed.

quote: Personnel matters, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution of the medicinal products, arrangements for dealing with complaints and recalls, and self inspection, should be examined at intervals following a pre-arranged programme in order to verify their conformity with the principles of Quality Assurance.
statement: Personnel, premises, equipment, documentation, production, quality control, distribution, complaint and recall arrangements, and self-inspection itself are examined at intervals under a pre-arranged programme to verify conformity with Quality Assurance principles.

quote: Self inspections should be conducted in an independent and detailed way by designated competent person(s) from the company.
statement: Self-inspections are carried out independently and in detail by designated competent company staff.

quote: Independent audits by external experts may also be useful.
statement: Independent audits by external experts may also be used.

quote: All self inspections should be recorded.
statement: Every self-inspection is recorded.

quote: Reports should contain all the observations made during the inspections and, where applicable, proposals for corrective measures.
statement: Self-inspection reports include all observations and, where applicable, proposed corrective measures.

quote: Statements on the actions subsequently taken should also be recorded.
statement: The actions taken after the self-inspection are recorded.

quote: If the report in question was from a routine audit to verify that the firm's quality system is operating as intended, then it would be acceptable if the firm elected to discard the report once all corrections have been verified.
statement: If a report comes from a routine audit verifying that the quality system works as intended, the firm may discard it once all corrections have been verified.

quote: However, any documentation of corrective action as a result of such an audit would have to be retained (see §§ 211.180 and 211.188).
statement: Documentation of corrective actions resulting from an internal audit is retained (21 CFR 211.180 and 211.188).

quote: if a routine internal audit finds a problem with a mixing step and the outcome is a change in mixing time, all affected procedures, including the master production record, are to reflect the necessary changes
statement: If an internal audit leads to a process change (for example a new mixing time), all affected procedures, including the master production record, are updated to reflect it.

quote: Any investigation into the impact this problem had on related batches is to be retained and also made available for inspection by FDA (see § 211.192).
statement: Any investigation of the problem's impact on related batches is retained and made available for FDA inspection (21 CFR 211.192).

quote: Such records are subject to FDA inspection and must be retained for at least the time specified in the CGMP regulations (see § 211.180).
statement: Reports of investigations or evaluations for complaints, vendor qualification, periodic record and data review, and failure investigations are open to FDA inspection and kept for at least the period set in the CGMP regulations (21 CFR 211.180).

quote: product realisation is achieved by designing, qualifying, planning, implementing, maintaining and continuously improving a system that allows the consistent delivery of products with appropriate quality attributes
statement: The quality system is designed, qualified, planned, implemented, maintained and continuously improved so products with the right quality attributes are delivered consistently.

quote: product and process knowledge is managed throughout all lifecycle stages
statement: Product and process knowledge is managed across every lifecycle stage.

quote: pharmaceutical products are designed and developed in a way that takes into account, the requirements of GMP and other GXPs such as those of Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Clinical Practices (GCP)
statement: Product design and development take into account GMP and other GxP requirements such as GLP and GCP.

quote: production and quality control operations shall be clearly specified in a written form and GMP requirements are adopted
statement: Production and QC operations are clearly specified in writing and GMP requirements are adopted.

quote: managerial responsibilities are clearly specified in the job descriptions
statement: Management responsibilities are clearly set out in job descriptions.

quote: arrangements are made for the manufacture, supply and use of the correct starting and packaging materials, the selection and monitoring of suppliers and for verifying that each delivery is the correct material from the approved supply chain
statement: Arrangements exist for making, supplying and using the correct starting and packaging materials, for selecting and monitoring suppliers, and for checking each delivery is the correct material from the approved supply chain.

quote: all necessary controls on starting materials, intermediate products, and bulk products and other in- process controls, calibrations and validations are carried out
statement: All necessary controls on starting materials, intermediates and bulk products, other in-process controls, calibrations and validations are performed.

quote: the finished product is correctly processed and checked, according to the defined procedures
statement: The finished product is correctly processed and checked to defined procedures.

quote: pharmaceutical products are not sold or supplied before the authorised persons have certified that each production batch has been produced and controlled in accordance with the requirements of the licence and other applicable regulations relevant to the production, control and release of pharmaceutical products
statement: No product is sold or supplied until the authorised persons have certified that each batch was produced and controlled in line with the licence and other applicable production, control and release regulations.

quote: processes are in place to ensure the management of outsourced activities
statement: Processes are in place to manage outsourced activities.

quote: satisfactory arrangements exist to ensure, as far as possible, that the pharmaceutical products are stored, distributed and subsequently handled so that quality is maintained throughout their shelf-life
statement: Arrangements are in place so that, as far as possible, storage, distribution and later handling maintain product quality throughout shelf life.

quote: there is a procedure for self-inspection or quality audit that regularly appraises the effectiveness and applicability of the product quality system
statement: A self-inspection or quality audit procedure regularly appraises the effectiveness and applicability of the product quality system.

quote: product and processes are monitored and the results taken into account in batch release, in the investigation of deviations and, with a view to taking preventive action to avoid potential deviations occurring in the future
statement: Products and processes are monitored and the results are used in batch release, deviation investigations and preventive action against future deviations.

quote: arrangements are in place for the prospective evaluation and approval of planned changes and their approval prior to their implementation, taking into account regulatory notification and approval where required
statement: Planned changes are evaluated and approved in advance, before implementation, taking regulatory notification and approval into account where required.

quote: After implementation of any change, an evaluation is undertaken to confirm that the quality objectives were achieved and that there was no unintended adverse impact on product quality
statement: After any change is implemented, it is evaluated to confirm the quality objectives were met and product quality was not adversely affected unintentionally.

quote: regular reviews of the quality of pharmaceutical products are conducted with the objective of verifying the consistency of the process and identifying where there is a need for improvement
statement: Regular product quality reviews are carried out to verify process consistency and identify needed improvements.

quote: a state of control is established and maintained by developing and using effective monitoring and control systems for process performance and product quality
statement: A state of control is set up and kept through effective monitoring and control systems for process performance and product quality.

quote: continual improvement is facilitated through the implementation of quality improvements appropriate to the current level of process and product knowledge
statement: Continual improvement is supported by quality improvements suited to current process and product knowledge.

quote: there is a system for QRM
statement: A quality risk management system is in place.

quote: deviations, suspected product defects and other problems are reported, investigated and recorded
statement: Deviations, suspected product defects and other problems are reported, investigated and recorded.

quote: An appropriate level of root cause analysis is applied during such investigations.
statement: These investigations use an appropriate level of root cause analysis.

quote: The most likely root causes shall be identified
statement: The most likely root causes are identified.

quote: appropriate corrective and preventive actions shall be identified and taken
statement: Appropriate corrective and preventive actions are identified and implemented.

quote: The effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions shall be monitored.
statement: CAPA effectiveness is monitored.

quote: The manufacturer shall evaluate the results of the review and an assessment shall be made as to whether corrective and preventive actions or any revalidation shall be undertaken, under the product quality system.
statement: The manufacturer evaluates the quality review results and assesses whether corrective and preventive actions or revalidation are needed under the product quality system.

quote: Corrective and preventive actions shall be completed in a timely and effective manner, according to documented procedures.
statement: Corrective and preventive actions are completed on time and effectively, following documented procedures.

quote: There shall be procedures for the on-going management and review of these actions
statement: Procedures exist for the ongoing management and review of these actions.

quote: the effectiveness of these procedures shall be verified during self-inspection
statement: The effectiveness of these procedures is verified during self-inspection.

quote: Quality reviews may be grouped by product type e.g., solid dosage forms, liquid dosage forms, or sterile products, where scientifically justified.
statement: Where scientifically justified, quality reviews may be grouped by product type, such as solid, liquid or sterile products.

quote: There shall be a technical agreement in place between the various parties that defines their respective responsibilities in producing the quality review.
statement: A technical agreement defines each party's responsibilities for producing the quality review.

quote: The authorised person responsible for final batch certification shall ensure that the quality review is performed in a timely manner and is accurate.
statement: The authorised person responsible for final batch certification ensures the quality review is done on time and is accurate.

quote: The contract shall describe the handling of starting materials, intermediate, bulk and finished products, if they are rejected.
statement: The contract describes how rejected starting materials, intermediates, bulk and finished products are handled.

quote: It shall also describe the procedure to be followed if the contract analysis shows that the tested product must be rejected.
statement: The contract describes the procedure to follow if contract analysis shows the tested product has to be rejected.

quote: The self-inspection programme shall be designed to detect any shortcomings in the implementation of good manufacturing practices and to recommend the necessary corrective actions.
statement: The self-inspection programme is designed to find any GMP implementation shortcomings and recommend needed corrective actions.

quote: Self-inspections shall be performed routinely
statement: Self-inspections are carried out routinely.

quote: may be, in addition, performed on special occasions e.g., in the case of product recall or repeated rejections, or when an inspection by the regulatory authorities is announced
statement: Additional self-inspections may be carried out on special occasions, such as a product recall, repeated rejections or an announced regulatory inspection.

quote: The team responsible for self-inspection shall consist of personnel who can evaluate the implementation of good manufacturing practices objectively.
statement: The self-inspection team is made up of people able to assess GMP implementation objectively.

quote: All recommendations for corrective action shall be implemented.
statement: Every corrective action recommendation is implemented.

quote: The procedure for self-inspection shall be documented
statement: The self-inspection procedure is documented.

quote: there shall be an effective follow-up programme
statement: An effective self-inspection follow-up programme exists.

quote: Written instructions for self-inspection shall be established to provide a minimum and uniform standard of requirements.
statement: Written self-inspection instructions are established to give a minimum, uniform standard of requirements.

quote: These may include questionnaires on good manufacturing practices requirements covering at least the following items, namely:- (a) personnel; (b) premises including personnel facilities; (c) maintenance of buildings and equipment; (d) storage of starting materials and finished products; (e) equipment; (f) production and in-process controls; (g) quality control (QC); (h) documentation; (i) sanitation and hygiene; (j) validation and revalidation programmes; (k) calibration of instruments or measurement systems; (l) recall procedures; (m) complaints management; (n) labels control; and (o) results of previous self-inspections and any corrective steps taken.
statement: The self-inspection instructions may include GMP questionnaires covering at least personnel; premises and personnel facilities; building and equipment maintenance; storage of starting materials and finished products; equipment; production and in-process controls; QC; documentation; sanitation and hygiene; validation and revalidation; instrument calibration; recalls; complaints; label control; and previous self-inspection results and corrective steps.

quote: Management shall appoint a self-inspection team consisting of experts in their respective fields who are familiar with GMP.
statement: Management appoints a self-inspection team of subject experts who are familiar with GMP.

quote: The members of the team may be appointed from inside or outside the company.
statement: Self-inspection team members may come from inside or outside the company.

numbers: at least once in a year
quote: The frequency with which self-inspections are conducted may depend on company requirements but shall be at least once in a year.
statement: Self-inspections are carried out at a frequency set by company needs, but at least once a year.

quote: The frequency shall be stated in the procedure.
statement: The self-inspection frequency is stated in the procedure.

quote: A report shall be made at the completion of a self-inspection.
statement: A report is written when each self-inspection is completed.

quote: The report shall include the following, namely:- (a) self-inspection results; (b) evaluation and conclusions; and (c) recommended corrective actions.
statement: The self-inspection report contains the results, the evaluation and conclusions, and the recommended corrective actions.

quote: There shall be an effective follow-up programme.
statement: An effective self-inspection follow-up programme exists.

quote: The company management shall evaluate both the self-inspection report and the corrective actions as necessary.
statement: Company management evaluates the self-inspection report and the corrective actions, as necessary.

quote: It may be useful to supplement self-inspections with a quality audit.
statement: Self-inspections may be supplemented by a quality audit.

quote: Such audits may also be extended to suppliers and contractors.
statement: Quality audits may be extended to suppliers and contractors.

quote: The person responsible for quality control shall have responsibility, together with other relevant departments, for approving suppliers who can reliably supply starting and packaging materials that meet established specifications.
statement: The person responsible for quality control, together with other relevant departments, approves suppliers able to reliably supply starting and packaging materials that meet specifications.

quote: Before suppliers are approved and included in the approved suppliers’ list or specifications, they shall be evaluated.
statement: Suppliers are evaluated before being approved and added to the approved suppliers' list or specifications.

quote: The evaluation shall take into account a supplier’s history and the nature of the materials to be supplied.
statement: The supplier evaluation considers the supplier's history and the nature of the materials supplied.

quote: If an audit is required, it shall determine the supplier’s ability to conform with good manufacturing practices standards.
statement: If a supplier audit is required, it determines whether the supplier can meet GMP standards.

quote: The authorised person responsible for approving a batch for release shall always ensure that the following requirements have been met:- (a) the licence and the approval requirements for the product have been met for the batch concerned
statement: Before releasing a batch, the authorised person always confirms that the product licence and approval requirements are met for that batch.

quote: the principles and guidelines of GMP, as laid down in this Part, have been followed
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that the GMP principles and guidelines of this Part were followed.

quote: the principal manufacturing and testing processes have been validated
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that the main manufacturing and testing processes are validated.

quote: all the necessary checks and tests have been performed and account taken of the production conditions and manufacturing records
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that all needed checks and tests were done and that production conditions and manufacturing records were taken into account.

quote: any planned changes or deviations in manufacturing or QC have been notified in accordance with a well-defined reporting system before any product is released. Such changes may need notification and approval by the licensing authority
statement: Before any product is released, the authorised person confirms that planned changes or deviations in manufacturing or QC were reported through a well-defined reporting system; such changes may also need notifying to, and approval by, the licensing authority.

quote: any additional sampling, inspection, tests and checks have been carried out or initiated, as appropriate, to cover planned changes and deviations
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that any extra sampling, inspection, tests and checks needed to cover planned changes and deviations were done or started, as appropriate.

quote: all necessary production and QC documentation has been completed and endorsed by supervisors trained in appropriate disciplines
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that all needed production and QC documents are complete and signed off by supervisors trained in the relevant disciplines.

quote: appropriate audits, self-inspections and spot-checks are carried out by experienced and trained staff
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that appropriate audits, self-inspections and spot-checks are done by experienced, trained staff.

quote: approval has been given by the head of quality control
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that the head of quality control has given approval.

quote: all relevant factors have been considered, including the factor associated with the output batch directly under review (e.g., sub-division of output batches from a common input, factors associated with continuous production runs)
statement: Before release, the authorised person confirms that all relevant factors were considered, including those tied to the specific output batch under review (such as sub-division of output batches from a common input, or continuous production runs).

quote: The main responsibilities of the independent quality units shall not be delegated.
statement: The main responsibilities of the independent quality unit are not delegated.

quote: These responsibilities shall be described in writing
statement: The quality unit's responsibilities are set out in writing.

quote: releasing or rejecting all APIs
statement: The quality unit releases or rejects every API.

quote: Releasing or rejecting intermediates for use outside the control of the manufacturing company
statement: The quality unit releases or rejects intermediates that will be used outside the manufacturer's control.

quote: establishing a system to release or reject raw materials, intermediates, packaging and labelling materials
statement: The quality unit sets up a system for releasing or rejecting raw materials, intermediates, and packaging and labelling materials.

quote: reviewing completed batch production and laboratory control records of critical process steps before release of the API for distribution
statement: The quality unit reviews completed batch production and laboratory control records for critical process steps before an API is released for distribution.

quote: making sure that critical deviations are investigated and resolved
statement: The quality unit makes sure critical deviations are investigated and resolved.

quote: approving all speciﬁcations and master production instructions
statement: The quality unit approves all specifications and master production instructions.

quote: approving all procedures impacting the quality of intermediates or APIs
statement: The quality unit approves every procedure that affects the quality of intermediates or APIs.

quote: making sure that internal audits (self-inspections) are performed
statement: The quality unit makes sure internal audits (self-inspections) take place.

quote: approving intermediate and API contract manufacturers
statement: The quality unit approves contract manufacturers of intermediates and APIs.

quote: approving changes that potentially impact quality of intermediates or APIs
statement: The quality unit approves changes that could affect the quality of intermediates or APIs.

quote: reviewing and approving validation protocols and reports
statement: The quality unit reviews and approves validation protocols and reports.

quote: making sure that quality related complaints are investigated and resolved
statement: The quality unit makes sure quality-related complaints are investigated and resolved.

quote: making sure that effective systems are used for maintaining and calibrating critical equipment
statement: The quality unit makes sure effective systems are used to maintain and calibrate critical equipment.

quote: making sure that materials are appropriately tested and the results are reported
statement: The quality unit makes sure materials are tested appropriately and results are reported.

quote: making sure that there are stability data to support retest or expiry dates and storage conditions on APIs or intermediates where appropriate
statement: The quality unit makes sure stability data exist to support retest or expiry dates and storage conditions for APIs or intermediates, where appropriate.

quote: performing product quality reviews as deﬁned in paragraph 2.5
statement: The quality unit performs product quality reviews as defined in paragraph 2.5.

quote: In order to verify compliance with the principles of GMP for APIs, regular internal audits shall be performed in accordance with an approved schedule.
statement: Regular internal audits are carried out to an approved schedule to verify compliance with GMP for APIs.

quote: Audit ﬁndings and corrective actions shall be documented and brought to the attention of the responsible management of the ﬁrm.
statement: Audit findings and corrective actions are documented and reported to the firm's responsible management.

quote: Agreed corrective actions shall be completed in a timely and effective manner.
statement: Agreed corrective actions are completed on time and effectively.
